Name: No Cellar Clutter
Author: Scocou
Description:
[b][color=#00ffff]No Cellar Clutter[/color][/b] removes all (5) clutter objects (barrels and wood piles) from the cellar.

That's all it does - it neither changes the size of the cellar, nor adds a crime-fighting Batcomputer™.

I was unable to find a mod that [i]only [/i]removed cellar clutter, so I made this. Apologies if I duplicated something existing.

This being my first Stardew Valley mod, any feedback is appreciated. Cheers!

[color=#00ffff][b]* I no longer play SDV so I won't be updating this mod to v1.3. Anyone is free to do so if they wish, full permission is granted. *
[/b][/color]
[b][color=#ffff00]Compatibility[/color][/b][list]
[*]Tested with Stardew Valley v1.2 only. Reported to [b]not[/b] work with v1.3 multiplayer.
[*]Should be compatible with anything that doesn't modify [code]Cellar.tbin[/code] or its containing archive: [code]Content/Maps/Cellar.xnb[/code]
[/list][b][color=#ffff00]
Dependencies[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Content Patcher requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]If anyone prefers an [code].xnb[/code] version just ask, I'll post an optional download.
[/list][b]
[color=#ffff00]To Install[/color][/b][list]
[*]Does [b]not [/b]require a new game. You can install this without altering your existing cask layout. Upon loading, the previously cluttered tiles will be empty.
[*]Extract the downloaded archive to your regular [code]Mods\[/code] directory. The resulting path should be: [code]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] NoClutterCellar\[/code]
[/list]
[b][color=#ffff00]To Uninstall[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Remove casks from upper-right and lower-left areas of cellar or they could be superimposed over clutter and potentially unmovable.
[*]Delete the previously extracted directory: [code]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] NoClutterCellar\[/code]
[/list]
